parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch part of the electrical wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator that toggles the electrical circuit on or off when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally around a hinge or spring mechanism to open or close the circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the electrical wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism and electrical sockets in place, ensuring insulation and mounting stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or mounting box, providing a stable base for the switch assembly.
